dom.text:
Origin
← Back to Labs
Research snapshot
Published research snapshot. Bounded Gym evidence from a pinned private pipeline. These metrics are not re-derivable from the public repository. Synthetic demonstrations, generated counterfactuals, and authorized fixtures do not establish real customer readiness.
ORIGIN - ROBOT-READINESS GYM
A bounded gym where a fast proposer is checked by a deterministic verifier and a ground-truth oracle.
Gemma proposes · Origin verifies · the oracle is the judge — a bounded robot-readiness Gym, not production robot certification.
Honest boundary: room-type classification is structural reading, while the v1 safety policy recovers the oracle from raw geometry. The full 36-feature perfect score is an oracle-recovery upper bound, not the headline. The budget pass is the learned mixed-holdout policy result; the reachability pass is an oracle-recovery upper bound because safe_reach_* is a precomputed flood-fill feature matching the oracle's own reachability check. Cerebras/Gemma mines hard cases; Origin's deterministic oracle labels them. Nothing here certifies a physical robot.

Three lanes, three different claims

The same score can mean different things depending on rights. Research-only rows can support papers and prototype demos; commercial-safe synthetic rows can support product-development demos; customer-owned rows are the path to real deployment evidence. The lane gate fails if research-only data is treated as commercial-safe.

Research prototype, benchmark, and non-commercial evaluation only. Not a commercial training or customer safety claim.

Passing this gate is limited bounded-Gym evidence, not certification.
